about: Version pairs ordered by Composer's own comparator (composer/semver 3, after VersionParser::normalize) in composer:2, on real versions from Packagist and OSV bounds for Packagist advisories; sampled so every shape of version appears. order: -1 below, 0 equal, 1 above. readable: whether Composer accepts the string as a version. 'forms' ranks every pair among 49 hand-listed spellings (-dev, -PL, stable, dates, build metadata, ...) that real data seldom has; the order is still Composer's.
